title: Triangulated closure of bounded constructible etale residue origin
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], A a commutative ring and I a maximal ideal. The property SfbConstructibleResidue of objects of D(Mod(completed A_X)) is closed under isomorphisms and triangulated. Here SfbConstructibleResidue is exactly the etale residue witness, bounded constructible cohomology, comparison isomorphism and finite Tor clause of IsSfbAdicConstructible [def-sfb-adic-stratified-perfect-data], with completeness omitted. The maximal ideal need not be unique, A need not be Noetherian or adically complete, and the residue field need not be finite.

proof.text: The scalar-forgetting functor from fixed-scalar sheaves to additive sheaves preserves finite limits and colimits and reflects both. Fixed-scalar restriction composed with it is the intrinsic module underlying-sheaf functor, which is exact. Hence fixed-scalar restriction is exact, and its derived composite with completed quotient reduction is triangulated.

Constructible etale module sheaves over a Noetherian residue field are closed under kernels, cokernels and extensions. The global extension consequence uses the same finite-presentation lifting proof on common strata; it does not require a finite underlying field. Consequently bounded constructible etale complexes form a triangulated full subcategory.

Derived comparison is fully faithful on bounded-below complexes. Its restriction to bounded constructible etale objects is therefore full and triangulated. The essential image of this restricted functor is triangulated and isomorphism-closed.

Identify the residue predicate with the inverse image of this essential image. In the forward direction Q(C) has the required bounds and constructible homology by the homology factor isomorphism. In the reverse direction take a cochain preimage of the etale object and use Q.objObjPreimageIso. Replace possibly unordered endpoints by min and max; transport vanishing and constructibility. The field-tensor theorem gives the Tor condition. Inverse image of a triangulated property along a triangulated functor is triangulated, giving both assertions.

theorem adicConstructible_residueTriangulated (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.IsMaximal) :
    ObjectProperty.IsClosedUnderIsomorphisms (SfbConstructibleResidue X I) ∧
      ObjectProperty.IsTriangulated (SfbConstructibleResidue X I)
